repos.name: hugohe3/ppt-master
repos.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered engine that generates native, editable PowerPoint presentations from documents or topics.
bullets: Built with Python, leveraging LLMs to structure content into slide decks.
Generates native PPTX files with shapes, transitions, animations, and data-backed charts.
Automates professional slide creation for financial reporting and corporate presentations.
Includes features for audio narration generation based on speaker notes.

repos.name: rociiu/talorys
repos.description: Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A personal AI agent framework designed for deployment within a private Cloudflare account.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture optimized for Cloudflare Workers and KV storage.
Provides a self-hosted environment for chat, memory management, and task scheduling.
Ideal for privacy-conscious users needing a persistent, low-cost agentic infrastructure.
Supports one-command deployment via npx for rapid setup of personal automation workflows.

repos.name: aindeev/agent-chrome-relay
repos.description: Let your AI agents use your Chrome, signed in as you, in background tabs. By Alexey Indeev · blog: read.aindeev.com · X: @AlexeyIndeev
repos.one_liner: A bridge that allows AI agents to interact with the Chrome browser using the user's authenticated session.
bullets: JavaScript-based relay that bridges external AI agents to local browser instances.
Enables agents to perform authenticated actions in background tabs as the user.
Solves the 'auth' bottleneck for agentic web automation and data scraping tasks.
Useful for building agents that require access to financial dashboards or SaaS tools.

repos.name: Jakubantalik/transitions.dev
repos.description: UI montion AI agent, a library of 43+ crafted transitions, a skill that fits your workflow.
repos.one_liner: A library of motion transitions designed to be integrated into AI-driven UI workflows.
bullets: Collection of 43+ high-quality, crafted UI transitions.
Focuses on enhancing the visual polish of AI-generated interfaces.
Provides a standardized skill set for developers building agentic UI/UX.
Simplifies the implementation of complex motion design in modern web applications.

repos.name: krishhgg/Insomnia
repos.description: A macOS menu bar app that keeps a MacBook awake safely for timed agent sessions.
repos.one_liner: A macOS utility designed to keep systems awake during long-running AI agent or background tasks.
bullets: Swift-based macOS menu bar application for system power management.
Prevents sleep cycles to ensure uninterrupted execution of agentic sessions.
Essential infrastructure for local LLM processing or long-running data analysis.
Provides a lightweight, non-intrusive solution for maintaining uptime on development machines.
